title: oxa loss record
description: A single loss record as defined by spec/02-loss-policy.md. Vectors and implementations carry lists of these; each record validates against this schema individually.

path.description: Root-relative dot/bracket path into the source payload, e.g. messages[2].content[0].cache_control; empty string denotes the payload root.

field.description: Leaf field name (or value identifier) at path.

reason.description: Every loss carries a reason code (spec/02 s3). degraded is reserved for best-effort carry with known distortion, never for drops.

detail.description: Human-readable context; should name what was dropped or distorted.
